name: Milk or Cream Codfish
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: large tablespoonful of salt codfish
ingredients.originalText: a large tablespoonful of salt codfish

ingredients.name: half a cupful of milk or thin cream
ingredients.originalText: half a cupful of milk or thin cream
ingredients.quantityText: half a cupful of milk or thin cream

ingredients.name: one teaspoonful of flour or cornstarch
ingredients.originalText: one teaspoonful of flour or cornstarch
ingredients.quantityText: one teaspoonful of flour or cornstarch

instructions.text: Pick up a large tablespoonful of salt codfish very fine
Freshen it considerably by placing it over the fire in a basin, covering it with cold water as it comes to a boil
Turn off the water and freshen again if very salt, then turn off the water until dry
Pour over half a cupful of milk or thin cream, add a bit of butter, a sprinkle of pepper, and a thickening made of one teaspoonful of flour or cornstarch, wet up with a little milk
When this boils up, turn over a slice of dipped toast

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Pick up a large tablespoonful of salt codfish very fine
2. Freshen it considerably by placing it over the fire in a basin, covering it with cold water as it comes to a boil
3. Turn off the water and freshen again if very salt, then turn off the water until dry
4. Pour over half a cupful of milk or thin cream, add a bit of butter, a sprinkle of pepper, and a thickening made of one teaspoonful of flour or cornstarch, wet up with a little milk
5. When this boils up, turn over a slice of dipped toast
